title: Desk Reference: Crestline Companion Fare Refunds on Cancelled Bookings
content:
When a companion booking made on Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes is cancelled, the companion fare charged for it is refunded to the holder by the companion desk in one refund entry that names that companion fare charge. The refund appears on the certificate or pass as a refund of component companion fare, and the holder's companion charges fall by the amount refunded.

## Capability

`refund_companion_fare_charge_1d800070` records, on the trip and charge history of one certificate or pass, one refund of component companion fare dated the current business date. The refund names the companion fare charge it refunds and carries that charge's companion ticket number.

## How it is invoked

The tool is agent-side: the agent unlocks `refund_companion_fare_charge_1d800070` and then calls it. The refund is recorded by the companion desk; the holder does not run it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `companion_id` | Reference number of the companion certificate or pass record the refund is recorded on, as returned by the companion certificate and pass lookup | identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `reversed_entry_id` | Reference number of the companion fare charge entry being refunded, as returned by the companion trip and charge history lookup | identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `amount` | The companion fare amount refunded | USD, a decimal number rounded to 2 decimal places (cents), rounding half up; never negative |

A parameter's presence means only that the value is supplied when the tool is called.

## Return

A receipt with: `refund_entry_id` (reference number of the new refund), `companion_id` (the certificate or pass), `refunded_charge_entry_id` (the charge refunded), `charge_component` (always `companion_fare`), `amount_usd` (USD with 2 decimal places), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's business date) and `status` (`refund_recorded` when the refund is on file). No error receipt is defined.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Called on a certificate with the reference of a companion fare charge and an amount of 119.00, the receipt shows `charge_component` `companion_fare`, `amount_usd` 119.00, today's date and `status` `refund_recorded`.
